finding: Both notice-index candidates were read from their page images. bfc-2021-146:p36 (page 37) prints A139 under Chambolle-Musigny, not Aloxe-Corton, and is recorded as rejected. bfc-2022-044:p18 (page 19), the Thibaut Marion receipt for dossier 2021-180, prints Ladoix-Serrigny AK159, AK164 and AK36, all current Corton parcels; the curation records one historical-application event on them. The receipt does not authorise cultivation, and no outcome or operation is established. The raw OCR sweep's other hits naming a bundle commune, bfc-2020-072:p58 (Michel Gayot et Fils, dossier 2019-173, page 59: Pernand-Vergelesses A1 to I1) and bfc-2022-059:p48 (EARL de Chenove, dossier 2021-179, page 49: Pernand-Vergelesses C and AC references, Savigny-les-Beaune D references), were read from their page images; none of their references is reachable from this cru. All other raw hits never name a bundle commune and are recorded but not assigned.
